zh.title: NTSB公佈佛羅裏達州Learjet 60墜機殘骸回收進度
zh.summary: NTSB公佈Learjet 60殘骸回收進度；佛州墜機原因未明，調查持續
body: 美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）表示，11月8日的更新指出，部分殘骸已送往華盛頓的實驗室。NTSB列出的已尋獲部件包括來自兩側機翼及兩具引擎的組件、駕駛艙、垂直尾翼、左側升降舵、副翼部分及多個襟翼滑軌組件。
Learjet 60於11月1日在佛羅裏達州Palm Beach County墜毀，機上9人全數罹難。該機由Aurora Aviation以Upper Jets名義營運。NTSB正在調查天氣狀況及空中解體證據，尚未確認事故原因，調查仍在進行。

en.title: NTSB reports Learjet 60 wreckage recovery after Florida crash
en.summary: NTSB reports Learjet 60 wreckage recovery; Florida crash cause remains unconfirmed as investigation continues
body: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) said on 8 November that parts of the wreckage had been sent to its laboratories in Washington. The agency listed components from both wings and both engines, as well as the flight deck, vertical stabilizer, left elevator, aileron sections and multiple flap-track assemblies.

The Learjet 60 crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida, on 1 November, killing all nine people aboard. It was operated by Aurora Aviation under the Upper Jets name. The NTSB is investigating weather conditions and evidence of an in-flight breakup, but has not confirmed a cause; the investigation is ongoing.
